description: This is a PHP source file defining a Smarty plugin function 'sugar_image', which generates HTML for displaying images, typically icons, used within the SugarCRM application. It includes a function that handles parameters for image selection, size, and alternative images, and returns the result of a helper function call.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_image
methods.description: A Smarty plugin function that generates and returns HTML for displaying an image, with parameters for customization and fallback images.
